packageRules.description: Dependabot owns ordinary dependency maintenance in this repository. Renovate is here for the design system alone, and everything else stays off so the two never open the same pull request twice.

A design-system bump is a retrofit work item, never dependency maintenance: it re-renders the whole app. Pinned exactly, never grouped, never automerged, one at a time. Inert until this repository installs the package — it vendors the tokens today.
packageRules.prTitle: [RENOVATE] 42labs Design System Version Bump: v{{{currentVersion}}} to v{{{newVersion}}}
prBodyNotes: The gate on this pull request compares the two releases and comments with what actually differs — every token declaration and every component. If it found nothing, it merges this itself and says so.
If it did find something: run the full visual matrix light and dark across breakpoints, and report any removed or renamed token reference rather than resolving it silently.
